headline: Mexican peso reduces its recovery against the dollar and is set for a weekly drop of almost 3%
summary: The peso reversed part of its rebound from near 19 per dollar, heading for a weekly decline of almost 3% amid shifting interest rate expectations.
why: The peso is Mexico's currency, and its level is sensitive to expectations for Banxico policy rates and to global risk sentiment.
why_moved: Changing expectations for interest rates weighed on the peso during the week, according to the report.
original_headline: Peso mexicano reduce su recuperación frente al dólar y perfila caída semanal de casi 3%
